vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: macro-helper
Version: 1.0.6

The macro-helper skill bundle is a legitimate utility for generating, explaining, and debugging Excel VBA code. The primary script, scripts/macro.sh, provides well-structured VBA templates and best practices, while scripts/script.sh serves as a local logging and data management tool. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection was found.

llm.summary: The skill's requested artifacts and behavior align with an Excel/VBA helper: it generates and explains VBA, includes local helper scripts, and does not request credentials or reach out to the network.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (VBA/macro helper) match the included instructions and scripts: macro.sh produces VBA templates/explanations/debugging guidance and script.sh provides a small local data/log utility. Nothing requested is unrelated to generating or managing macros.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to run bash scripts/macro.sh to produce code/explanations — that matches the files. The runtime scripts themselves generate VBA and provide templates/debugging tips only. Minor scope note: the auxiliary script.sh persists logs/data to a local data directory (see below), which the SKILL.md does not explicitly call out.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no remote downloads are present. The skill is instruction-only with included local scripts, so nothing is pulled from external URLs at install time.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no credentials or special environment variables. It does read standard fallback variables (MACRO_HELPER_DIR / XDG_DATA_HOME / HOME) to decide where to store data; this is reasonable but means the skill will create files under the user's data directory by default.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not attempt to modify other skills or system-wide settings. It does persist logs/data locally (DATA_DIR defaults to ~/.local/share/macro-helper) which is expected for a helper tool.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for generating/explaining VBA, and it does not request credentials or make network calls. Before installing or running it: (1) review generated VBA code before enabling macros in Excel — macros can perform file I/O and send email (templates include Outlook usage), so verify recipients and .Send/.Display behavior; (2) note the helper will create a data directory (default ~/.local/share/macro-helper) with history.log and data.log — inspect these if you care about local persistence; (3) if you need stronger isolation, run the scripts in a sandbox or VM; (4) avoid running macros produced by untrusted sources in high-privilege documents. Overall the skill is internally consistent and does what it claims.
